scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run db:migrate:remote && WRANGLER_OUTPUT_FILE_PATH=/tmp/codice-wrangler-$WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA.ndjson wrangler versions upload --tag $WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA && pnpm exec sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org $SENTRY_ORG --project codice-api --release $WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA --strip-prefix 'dist/..' --validate --strict --wait dist && wrangler versions deploy --version-id $(node -e 'const entry = JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync("/tmp/codice-wrangler-" + process.env.WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA + ".ndjson", "utf8").trim().split("\n").at(-1)); if (entry.type !== "version-upload" || !entry.version_id) throw new Error("Missing uploaded Worker version ID"); process.stdout.write(entry.version_id)') --yes && wrangler triggers deploy
scripts.eval: doppler run -p codice -c dev -- tsx scripts/eval.ts
